_doc: Paladin spec models. Holy: Flash of Light / Holy Light healer. Retribution: two-hander with seal procs and Judgements (Seal of Command is a talent -> damage effect). Protection: shield tank whose threat is Holy Strike (Forever baseline), Consecration, seal/judgement, Retribution Aura and white swings; Holy Shield arrives as a talent effect. Per-game overrides zero out abilities that do not exist in that game. mana_weight per model overrides the raid profile's mana weight for mana-bound specs; pet_dmg_to_surv turns pet damage into pet threat (fewer hits on you); profile_overrides changes a source per profile. min_level/max_level are Classic learn levels (Forever unlock levels are a beta check).

holy-heal.note: Raid healing: Flash of Light 55%, Holy Light 35%, Holy Shock 5% (talent/instant), Lay on Hands 5%. Beta client 1.60.1.70009 (2026-09-25 refresh, see <class>/spells/README.md): Holy Shock rank 1 is learned at 30 (128-140, 10s cooldown), Flash of Light and Holy Light gained five ranks each, Lay on Hands has a 20 min cooldown. Healer lab shares (2026-09-30, holy-raid-healer): holy_light 52%, flash 44%, loh 3%, holy_shock 0%; 0% of the healing came from talent-taught spells the model carries as talent effects.

ret-dps.note: Two-handed Retribution: white 45%, seal procs 25% (Seal of Command via talent, Seal of Righteousness otherwise), Judgements 15%, Consecration 8%, Holy Strike 7% (Forever baseline ability; absent in Classic). Beta client 1.60.1.70009 (2026-09-25 refresh, see <class>/spells/README.md): Holy Strike is baseline from level 6 with eight ranks (rank 8: 50% weapon damage plus 40-53 Holy, 20 mana, 10s cooldown since build 70009; Improved Holy Strike was removed); Consecration has an 8s cooldown; Judgement no longer consumes the seal; Exorcism and Hammer of Wrath are ~10% lower than Classic. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, beta client 1.60.1.70291, build opt-ret-dps-leveling-aoe at level 60, 1500 fights): shares are the measured damage split (Melee 38%, Seal of Command 18%, Judgement 18%, Holy Strike 16%, Hammer of Wrath 11%) and the leveling time split is fight 86% / drink 5% / eat 4% / other 0% / death 5% of talent-affected time with fight_coupling 1.0 (downtime and deaths scale with fight length). Raid sim shares (2026-10-03, ret-raid-dps in the ElliotWood/Forever simulator b0f0df3, every mana-only buff on: the split before the mana limit): seal 32%, white 18%, judgement 16%, consecration 15%, holy_strike 13%, hammer_of_wrath 6%; 3% of the damage matched no source.
ret-dps.kind_note: Melee playstyle: it fights in melee range and never kites, so roots and slows used to open distance (kite) and longer spell or shot range (range) are worth nothing to it in any scenario. Snares that stop a runner (stick), stuns and movement still count.

forever.note: Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, training dummy): the builds lose 4-6% of their damage to mana (the same builds gain that much with every mana-only buff on); the mana-bound damage (every source but white attacks and pets) shrinks by min(cap, max(0, loss - (sustain - 1))), loss and cap fitted to those deficits and to the removal runs of the pure mana talents (the same build with less mana), the mana talents' sustain to their removal runs. Re-run the calibration instead of editing.

prot-tank.note: Shield tank: Consecration 25%, Holy Strike 20% (Forever; Classic uses Seal/Judgement of Righteousness instead), seal+judgement 15%, Retribution Aura 10%, white 20%, Holy Shield blocks via talent. Beta client 1.60.1.70009 (2026-09-25 refresh, see <class>/spells/README.md): Holy Strike rank 8 is 50% weapon damage plus 40-53 every 10s (share 20 -> 18%); Consecration rank 5 deals 12 a tick to everyone plus 27 a tick to the first 4 enemies, 8s cooldown (share 25 -> 27%); Righteous Fury's Holy threat bonus is +60% in build 70009 (was 90%); Holy Shield rank 3 221 per block at 0.08, rank 1 trains at 40. Raid sim shares (2026-10-03, prot-tank in the ElliotWood/Forever simulator b0f0df3): seal 34%, white 30%, consecration 17%, holy_strike 12%, ret_aura 6%; 15% of the damage matched no source.
prot-tank.kind_note: Melee playstyle: it fights in melee range and never kites, so roots and slows used to open distance (kite) and longer spell or shot range (range) are worth nothing to it in any scenario. Snares that stop a runner (stick), stuns and movement still count.
